source: Capital41 Structure Swings v3, ce64522f7f747abb00b37503c00e2955a6d687d2; threshold fixed at entry for this question.
single_variable: A 5m close crosses the most recent pre-entry confirmed 5-left/5-right swing high (long) or low (short), after entry through the first 1h confirmation close. Require previous close at or below / above; strict crossings. No new fills or changed exits.
pivot_cutoff: Pivot confirmation strictly before the entry close, excluding the touch candle. Freeze that level; no later pivot replacement. Strict highs/lows primary; allow equal on left and strict right as plateau sensitivity. Do not bridge missing candles.
landmark: Original native fill bar open floored to UTC hour + 2h. Primary population is reclaimed and still open strictly after this time on the archived per-event worse-net path. Record exit at the landmark separately. Count both OHLC orders independently for eligibility parity.
primary: Future near Monday-edge target and armed stop frequencies. Paired descriptive columns: original full-trade net bp and remaining mark-to-exit net bp per entry notional (full net less side-adjusted entry-to-confirm mark, add back sunk 15bp market entry costs). The remaining measure has no synthetic fill at the landmark.
comparisons: 2020-24 versus 2025 versus 2026, long/short, common and far candidate groups, funded 6x3 cohort, breakout pivot reachable strictly before target, plateau sensitivity. Week-cluster bootstrap 95% intervals; conditional null permutes breakout labels within UTC entry year, side and pre-entry target reachability among eligible positions. No changes to historical account execution.
fees: Frozen E20 native fills on Binance UM 5m. Entry taker 5bp and 10bp slippage, original target maker 2bp, other exits taker 5bp and 10bp slippage. Funding excluded.
